intent: Pause Dependabot version-update pull requests until release while keeping security updates available. Apply only the two open-PR limits to default-branch main under the operator's narrow exception, then mirror the same configuration on dev.

reasons.evidence: A minimal direct commit to main is externally consequential and the user explicitly approved this exact exception.
The default-branch configuration controls GitHub's version-update service.

programme: The operator chose to pause version PRs until release and then explicitly authorised a narrow exception to the dev-only push rule: change only main's .github/dependabot.yml to set both npm and GitHub Actions open-pull-requests-limit to zero. GitHub documents that Dependabot reads this file from the default branch and that zero blocks version updates without disabling security updates. All T-0172 hosted jobs completed successfully before this task opened.
invariants: The only main-tree content change is .github/dependabot.yml, adding open-pull-requests-limit: 0 for npm and GitHub Actions; preserve each target-branch: dev and every existing ignore rule.
Security updates and alerts remain enabled in repository settings; this task does not touch those settings.
The main update uses the exact current content SHA as a compare-and-swap guard, and the resulting main file is verified byte-for-byte against the reviewed proposal.
Dev receives the same configuration so its single PR back to main remains coherent. PR #157 and all other branches are unchanged by this task.
A separately authored red-first oracle, complete unchanged-tree gate, committed-tree mutation sweep and observed hosted jobs precede closure.
rollback: Set the two open-pull-requests-limit values back to their prior configuration on main and dev using a new reviewed commit; keep security settings untouched. The release will deliberately lift this temporary pause and amend its oracle through an independent author.
oracle_provenance: Pending independent ORACLE author, before implementation.
